sample_unit: participants (patients with rare diseases and caregivers)
unlisted_practices: Telemedicine platform with AI-based pre-consultation summaries compared with in-person care for rare disease patients and caregivers, measuring quality of life, depression, satisfaction, and cost

screen.reason: The study evaluates a real-world deployment of a telemedicine platform incorporating AI-based pre-consultation summaries for rare disease patients/caregivers and clinicians, but evaluates the overall platform rather than isolating or testing an AI deployment guardrail/practice.
